# edgeos_port_forward_settings (Resource)

The global port forwarding options (`port-forward`). There is only one of these per router, so the resource takes over the existing node on create and the ID is always `port-forward`.

The resource only manages the attributes you set. Attributes left unset are not read or changed, and destroying the resource removes only the attributes it managed. Port forwarding rules below `port-forward rule` are never touched; manage them with `edgeos_port_forward`.

EdgeOS refuses to commit port forwarding rules without `wan_interface` and `lan_interfaces`, so set both as soon as any rule exists, and do not destroy them while rules remain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "edgeos_port_forward_settings" "this" {
  wan_interface  = "eth0"
  lan_interfaces = ["switch0"]
  hairpin_nat    = true
  auto_firewall  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_firewall` (Boolean) Let EdgeOS add the firewall rules that allow the forwarded traffic in (`auto-firewall enable`). Unset leaves the current setting alone.
- `hairpin_nat` (Boolean) Make forwarded ports reachable from the LAN through the WAN address (`hairpin-nat enable`). Unset leaves the current setting alone.
- `lan_interfaces` (Set of String) Interfaces the LAN hosts live on, used for hairpin NAT, such as `["switch0"]`.
- `wan_interface` (String) Interface the forwarded ports are opened on, such as `eth0` or `pppoe0`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `port-forward`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = edgeos_port_forward_settings.example
  id = "port-forward"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import edgeos_port_forward_settings.example 'port-forward'
```
